svg.aria-label: Robots build, test and teach the next robot in an original pixel-art orbital workshop
svg.title: The next builder
svg.desc: Original 16-bit science-fiction adventure illustration. In an orbital workshop, two robots assemble a new robot, test it, share their build guide and welcome it to the crew. The new builder helps with the next chassis. A twelve-second conceptual story, not an engineering simulation or a claim of automatic model training. People review and share the real project knowledge.
